text_block_list.text:
When I visited the park, among the 
bustling crowd, I spotted a student from 
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whaa, looks like everyone's gathered here 
after all~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
They're filming a movie based on a shoujo 
manga~! It's all anyone's been talking 
about at the academy~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh? Dober-san came to watch too~!

text_block_list.name: Fan Girl
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~ The girl playing the heroine is so 
super cute~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Ngh, ...I can't see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...What am I doing, really. I-I should 
just go home.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Up... we... gooo~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eh!? Wah, kyaaa...!?

Hishi Akebono lifted Mejiro Dober high 
above the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: How's that~? Can you see now~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Eh... ah, I see her... No way, she's cute. 
So incredibly cute...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you... Akebono. But why are you 
here?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Because I saw you hopping up and down at 
the very back of the crowd, Dober-san~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Do you like that actress, Dober-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-It's not really like that, though...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Besides, it doesn't suit me, does it? 
Me, being a fan of someone that cute—

text_block_list.name: Actress
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you with the twin tails over there! 
Are you interested in theater?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Eh, no way... Wait, Akebono! That person 
is...!

text_block_list.name: Actress
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. Up close, you really are 
gigantic! You totally stood out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank youuu~! Being big is something 
I'm really proud of~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
During winning lives, being big lets me 
deliver my dancing all the way to the fans 
in the back, so it's a huge plus~!

text_block_list.name: Actress
text_block_list.text:
How lovely, you're practically glowing. 
That brilliance only comes with true 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Actress
text_block_list.text:
It's really a shame, but since you're a 
racehorse girl, I suppose scouting you is 
out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, but I'm still happy. Thank youuu~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Akebono is amazing. ...Confidence... 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Could you give me... an autograph, 
...!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad for you, Dober-san♪ You have 
such a woooonderful smile right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It's thanks to you, Akebono. Because 
you stood so tall and proud.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I just figured, for an actress I love 
so much, I should face her with confidence 
as my true self.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! That is just super duper buono☆
